note: If no ffmpeg on this computer can encode with NVENC, the BtbN GPL build the site already mirrors (kit-ffmpeg.zip: ffnvcodec, libass, libx264...) is installed under <data>/tools/PersianAiKit/Video/tools/ffmpeg. gpu.best_ffmpeg() then prefers it. FFmpeg is GPL-3: the build is only run, never linked.
